entries.title: Psalms 97:1
segments: ¶Jehovah reigneth: let the earth be glad, let the many isles rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 97:2
segments: Clouds and darkness are round about him; righteousness and judgment are the foundation of his throne.

entries.title: Psalms 97:3
segments: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his adversaries round about.

entries.title: Psalms 97:4
segments: His lightnings lightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.

entries.title: Psalms 97:5
segments: The mountains melted like wax at the presence of Jehovah, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

entries.title: Psalms 97:6
segments: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the peoples see his glory.

entries.title: Psalms 97:7
segments: Ashamed be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols. Worship him, all ye gods.

entries.title: Psalms 97:8
segments: ¶Zion heard, and rejoiced; and the daughters of Judah were glad, because of thy judgments, O Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 97:9
segments: For thou, Jehovah, art the Most High above all the earth; thou art exalted exceedingly above all gods.

entries.title: Psalms 97:10
segments: Ye that love Jehovah, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints, he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 97:11
segments: Light is sown for the righteous, and joy for the upright in heart.

entries.title: Psalms 97:12
segments: Rejoice in Jehovah, ye righteous; and give thanks in remembrance of his holiness.
